name: C6-linked-library
description: Plan 8.4 C6: a write on a file linked to a large library. Step 1 links the run file to the library, step 2 creates one rectangle, and step 3 changes it 100 times at 10 writes per second. Compare the step 1 cost and the step 3 p95 with a run on an unlinked file. Needs ${libraryId} (the large file, for example from the large-vars file) and ${projectId}. Each write realises every linked library in full, so the p95 of step 3 shows the cost (SYS-06).
